profile.headline: Multi-discipline Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am an intelligent, hardworking individual that is transparent from the type of results I produce in both my professional and personal lives. I strive to be better every day through further education, persistence, and dedication.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies:
- Java, Scala, Python, C#, Samza, Kafka, .NET, Elasticsearch, Redis, Aerospike, InfluxDB, Opensearch, Kubernetes, GitLab, ELK, Grafana, Cerebro

Description:
Back-end engineer responsible for a high-availability distributed search system deployed in a Kubernetes environment.

Accomplishments:
	Converted the usage of Elasticsearch to Opensearch and integrated all our systems as well as external to use Opensearch which required API design changes, client code changes, and data model changes.
	Improved our data ingestion pipeline of web documents using Samza and Kafka allowing us to extract data more accurately and optimized our processing rate.
	Research and built a system to allow us to obtain millions of data from web archive files and load it into Opensearch at a reasonable rate though Kubernetes Job and Redis.
	Developed system metrics and monitoring using Grafana and InfluxDB.
	Configured Docker and CI/CD files to allow our applications to be deployed automatically in a Kubernetes cluster.
	Mentored junior engineers and collaborated with contractors, stakeholders, and other teammates throughout the development lifecycle.

positions.title: Senior DevSecOps Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies:
- Java, C#, React, Vue, Angular, Typescript, Docker, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, Ansible, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform

Description:
Consultant that builds software solutions for a variety of government contracts.

Accomplishments:
	Simultaneously worked and met deadlines for multiple projects.
	On most projects, provided object-oriented designs for features based on design patterns for the team to utilize.
	Collaborated with our stakeholders to gain understanding of their business and users’ needs and translate it to software solutions.
	Provided financial analysis capabilities using Java, React and PostgreSQL in a container and AWS-based infrastructure.
	Improved government security processes and procedures through automating a lot of its features in a C# and Vue application. In this project, I led the practice of TDD into our development process.
	Organized the process and finance of government project inception to execution through the development of a Java, Spring, Angular/TypeScript, and MongoDB application deployed in AWS. 
	Engineered DevOps pipelines and deployment environment using Jenkins and AWS.
	Built scripts in Python for automatic configuration of machines using Ansible.
	Provided demos for the team and stakeholders to assure the accuracy of the features created.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Technologies:
- Vert.x, Akka, Spring Boot, ReactJs, OpenShift Kubernetes, Docker, CheckMarx, SonarQube, Artifactory, NGINX, ELK, Java, Groovy, Python

Description:
Led the implementation of micro-services and infrastructure as code using several technologies for a government system. This includes the management of engineers, design of software applications, approach in testing from unit to integration level and interfacing with our government stakeholders.

Accomplishments:
 Developed several micro-services using different Java frameworks.
 Implemented the first system to use OpenShift with Kubernetes and containers through a micro-services architecture for the program I was working for.
 Developed CI/CD pipeline using infrastructure as code which included stages that produced quality and security reports on our application's artifacts.
 Architect some of our testing tools for integration based testing.
 Led a team of 12+ engineers, mentoring and assisting them throughout the software development life-cycle.
 Integrated our system with other systems within a cluster environment in a secured way.
 Defined coding and documentation conventions as well as processes that improved both the quality of our application and efficiency of our work.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technology Stacks:
(1) Embedded Linux (2) FreeRTOS

Description:
Engineered software for a variety of devices used for military training systems. These devices interface through both serial and wireless protocols and contains several peripherals such as GPS, RF Antennas, LTE Modems, and etc.

Accomplishments:
	Improved code based by implementing design patterns and utilizing programming conventions.
	Researched and resolved a critical bug that existed for several years when two devices are interfaced with each other.
	Integrated and defined a unit test framework and convention into software development process to improve both design and test coverage.
	Took on several roles in both development and design to meet project deadlines on several projects.
	Constructed designed documents and developed features from firmware drivers to device communication to a network.

positions.title: Graduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
Technology Stacks: 
(1) Python, Flask, Google Cloud Platform, MongoDB

Description: 
Researched technologies revolved around Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Edge Computing in developing an Edge Computing Architecture. This architecture is designed to improve the performance of an Artificial Intelligence based system. System performance improvements focused in processing time, data transfer size and battery life.

Technology Stacks: 
(1) Keras (Tensorflow), Flask, Unicorn (Linux), Waitress (Windows), Google Cloud Platform, Ansible, Docker

	Developed a system that distributed the CIFAR-10 neural network model between two devices to improve processing time and data transfer size.
	Architect an automated adjustable A.I. system that consist of Linux devices, Edge device and a Google Cloud Platform service. The A.I. system utilized different object detection neural network models (YOLO Version 2, YOLO Tiny Version 2, and Faster RCNN) to demonstrate edge computing's ability in improving a system's performance.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
Description: 
Assisted with the grading and teaching of students in CS 331 Computer Architecture course and CS 433 Operating Systems course.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technology Stacks:
(1) J2EE, Spring Bean, MSQL, Jenkins (2) Vaadin, Spring MVC, Jenkins, Maven
(3) Spring Boot, MSQL, Jenkins, Maven (4) React, Redux, Material UI, MSQL
(5) Java, XML, HTML, Velocity, MSQL

Description: 
Responsible for both server-side and client-side development of many systems (legacy and new) and tools within the insurance domain. Additionally, aid in the construction of well-defined requirements through collaboration with the development team, clients, and vendors.

Accomplishments:
	Designed new software modules and refactored legacy software modules using design patterns for maintainability, scalability and reusability. 
	Successfully completed multiple projects simultaneously on different systems.
	Pioneered microservice-based architecture into our systems.
	Integrated new software frameworks to improve development efficiency.
	Contributed to process improvements by introducing code reviews, initiating new SDLC workflows, and configuring automated unit testing within our build process.

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Technology Stacks:
(1) C# WPF, Selenium (2) C# ASP.NET MVC 4, Bootstrap, MongoDB

Description:
Quality assurance expert in automation process, development and maintenance.

Accomplishments:
	Improved the design and organization of our automation system.
	Dramatically increased code coverage of our automated integration tests.
	Developed web application tool to easily manage our integration testing initiatives.
	Started the documentation on features of our automation system.
	Mentored and trained Quality Assurance employees that later took over automation tasks.
	Became the main tester on effectively testing any system and product.
	Discovered and resolved many existing critical bugs.
	Fixed several existing automation issues.
	Dramatically increased automation testing coverage.
	Improved the integrity of system business logic.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Description:
Multi-disciplined developer on several components of a product lifecycle system. This includes working on the desktop application, web application and server configuration.

Accomplishments:

	Refactored existing code to comply with programming conventions.
	Acknowledged by our client for providing documentation on instructions on the software configuration, features and procedures.
	Effectively trained and managed new employees to get up to speed quickly.
